fn CheckLampArrangement(r: Int, g: Int, b: Int) -> Bool
  requires (r >= 1)
  requires (g >= 1)
  requires (b >= 1)
  ensures (result == ((2 * (if ((r >= g) and (r >= b)) then r else if ((g >= r) and (g >= b)) then g else b)) <= (((r + g) + b) + 1)))
  effects pure
  example (CheckLampArrangement(0, 0, 0) == true)
{
  true
}
